text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before the race, I visited the waiting room
where Fenomeno was on standby."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Boss!
Forgive me, I didn't notice you there...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Because I was simply concentrating on the race, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss? You're staring awfully hard at my face... Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her drive was on a completely different level than usual,
and I couldn't help but feel overwhelmed by it.
